items.title: Threat Detection
items.tagline: Spot danger before it becomes disaster.
items.intro: We continuously watch your networks, systems and cloud for suspicious behavior, using AI and expert analysts to separate real attacks from noise so you can respond in minutes instead of hours.
covers: Behavioral analytics to surface unusual logins, data movement and privilege changes
Alert triage that filters false positives and prioritises what matters
Detection use-cases mapped to common attack techniques
Clear escalation paths and runbooks for confirmed incidents

steps.title: Baseline
steps.text: We learn what normal looks like across identities, workloads and network traffic.

steps.title: Instrument
steps.text: Logs and telemetry from cloud, endpoints and applications are routed into one view.

steps.title: Detect
steps.text: Rules and machine-learning models flag deviations and known attack patterns.

steps.title: Respond
steps.text: Analysts validate alerts and guide containment, with lessons fed back into detection.

faqs.q: How does AI help with threat detection?
faqs.a: AI and machine learning highlight unusual patterns across large volumes of events that humans would miss, then rank them so analysts focus on the most dangerous activity first.

faqs.q: Will this create a flood of false alerts?
faqs.a: Detection is tuned to your environment and reviewed by analysts, so the goal is fewer, higher-quality alerts rather than more noise.

faqs.q: Does it cover cloud as well as on-premises systems?
faqs.a: Yes. Coverage spans cloud, endpoints and network traffic, scoped to the systems you want protected.

faqs.q: What happens when a real threat is found?
faqs.a: You receive a prioritised alert with context and recommended containment steps, and we help you respond.

items.title: Compliance Management
items.tagline: Turn complex regulation into a strategic advantage.
items.intro: We build controls, policies and audit-ready evidence into your cloud so you always know where sensitive data lives, who can access it and how it is protected.
covers: Gap assessments against the security and privacy standards that apply to you
Control design, policy writing and ownership mapping
Evidence collection that makes audits faster and less disruptive
Ongoing governance so compliance stays current as you change

steps.title: Scope
steps.text: Identify the regulations, customer requirements and data flows that apply.

steps.title: Assess
steps.text: Measure current controls against the requirements and rank the gaps.

steps.title: Remediate
steps.text: Implement controls and policies, prioritising the highest-risk gaps.

steps.title: Evidence
steps.text: Capture continuous proof so you are ready for auditors, customers and regulators.

faqs.a: We work to the frameworks relevant to your industry and customers. Tell us what you need during a consultation and we will scope it with you.
Yes. Building evidence collection into daily operations means audits draw on existing records rather than a last-minute scramble.
No. Regulations and your systems both change, so we treat compliance as an ongoing governance process.
Compliance sets a baseline. We pair it with detection and monitoring so you are protected, not just certified.

items.title: Continuous Monitoring
items.intro: Every login, configuration change and data flow in your cloud is watched in real time, so risky behavior is flagged instantly and small issues are contained before they grow into incidents.
covers: 24/7 visibility across identities, configurations and data flows
Detection of misconfigurations and drift from your security baseline
Real-time alerting with clear severity and ownership
Regular reporting on posture, trends and open risks

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: Integrate your cloud accounts and key systems with read-only access where possible.

steps.title: Watch
steps.text: Monitor activity and configuration continuously against your baseline.

steps.title: Alert
steps.text: Notify the right people the moment risky behavior appears.

steps.title: Improve
steps.text: Review trends and close recurring blind spots.

faqs.a: Our approach is built around round-the-clock coverage so suspicious activity is not left waiting until business hours.

faqs.q: Will monitoring slow down our systems?
faqs.a: Monitoring is designed to be non-intrusive and rely on logs and APIs rather than adding load to your workloads.
Alerts are routed to the owners you define, with severity levels so critical events get immediate attention.
Yes. You receive posture and trend reporting so stakeholders can see progress.

items.title: Tailored Solutions
items.intro: We align controls, policies and technology with your cloud architecture, risk profile and growth plans, so you close the gaps that matter and avoid paying for what you do not need.
covers: Risk assessment sized to your industry, scale and appetite
Roadmaps that sequence improvements by impact and effort
Right-sized tooling and process, not one-size-fits-all packages
Security that scales as you add apps, users and regions

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Understand your business, architecture and what you most need to protect.

steps.title: Prioritise
steps.text: Rank risks and choose the controls with the best return.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Implement a plan that fits your team, budget and timeline.

steps.title: Evolve
steps.text: Revisit the plan as your business and the threat landscape change.

faqs.a: We start from your needs rather than a fixed package, then scope the services that fit.

faqs.q: We are a small team. Is this suitable?
faqs.a: Yes. Plans are sized to your organisation, so you only invest in what reduces your real risk.

faqs.q: Can we start with one area and expand?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Many organisations begin with a single priority and grow coverage over time.
Use the contact form or book a consultation and we will discuss your situation.
